headlines.title: U.S. taking Putin’s side would be a ‘historic mistake,’ Zelenskyy says
headlines.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has warned that the U.S. formally siding with Russia’s Vladimir Putin would be a “historic mistake.” All of this comes as the midterms are just over two weeks away and a new NBC News poll shows 71 percent of Americans say the U.S. is on the wrong track. Voters were especially sour on the economy and gas prices. NBC News’ Yamiche Alcindor reports.

headlines.title: 4 service members killed and dozens injured in fire at Canadian military base
headlines.description: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney said Sunday that four service members were killed and dozens more seriously injured in a fire at a military base in Alberta, describing it as one of the worst peacetime tragedies for Canada’s military on domestic soil. NBC News’ Steven Romo reports.

headlines.title: Trump announces plans to renovate D.C. golf course amid legal battle
headlines.description: The announcement comes after a judge required the government to provide three days’ notice before making “irreparable modification” to the golf course.

headlines.title: California woman indicted on charges that she was spying for China
headlines.description: A California woman who prosecutors allege was spying on a son of Taiwan’s president was indicted earlier this month on charges of conspiracy and being an unregistered foreign agent for China.

headlines.title: ‘The house was toast’: Surf swallows California homes
headlines.description: The worst of El Niño is still months away, but Southern California’s fragile coastline is already being transformed by record-setting king tides and storm surges.

headlines.title: Miley Cyrus Honors Late Godmother Dolly Parton With Emotional Performance
headlines.description: Miley Cyrus performed a passionate rendition of her “Aunt Dolly’s” classic “Jolene” during her performance at the Hollywood Bowl in Los Angeles.
